name: Rubo Rentals Houston
reviewSnippets: Rented a corvette as a surprise for my husband’s birthday. The car was clean and amazing, the host was also very responsive. I will definitely rent from them again.
Great experience, Kendrick is an excellent host, very responsive and helpful. Car was clean, ran well, perfect for zipping around town. I will definitely be a returning customer.
The host was just shy of amazing! Can't believe how good of a condition the vehicle was, communication was on point. Even for small questions, he always picked up the phone! Will recommend 100%
